utterances.text: Hey Grandma, how's your day going? I'm setting up my live stream!
I'm glad to hear that! What are you excited about with this streaming?
I'm excited about the new video game I just got! I want to show people how to play it.
Yeah, it's got amazing graphics and a great storyline. Do you want to see the setup sometime?
It's really cool, Grandma! I think you'd enjoy seeing the colors. Maybe we can stream together.
Oh, I see! So the red light is important to know if the broadcast is on?
Yeah, the red light shows when the stream is live. It's pretty handy!
Alright, I'm coming over. Let's see what you've got there for the show.
Great! I'm sure you'll love it. Let's get the camera started!
Yes, I can see the lens clearly now. What do you want to show me on the monitor?
I wanted to show you how I talk to people in the chat. It's really fun and interactive!
Oh, I see. So the people watching might not see me here in the room?
No, they won't see you unless you sit by me. Do you want to try saying hi?
Oh, that's great! I'm glad I can say hello to your friends.
Actually, they can't see you yet because the camera is off. Want me to show you how to turn it on?
Oh, I understand now. So there's a little delay in what the audience is seeing?
Yes, there's a small delay. They see what we do a few seconds later. Let me show you.
Ah, I see. Thank you for explaining how the internet carries the video.
You're welcome! If you want, we can try starting a short stream together now.
Oh, I get it now. So I need to stay within the camera's view for them to see me during the live?
Exactly! Just make sure you're in the camera's view, and you'll be part of the broadcast.
Oh, I see! So I just need to be mindful of where the camera is pointing. Thank you for helping me understand.
No problem! Let me know if you have any other questions about the streaming platform.
Oh, I didn't mean to sound worried. I just meant it's a bit strange to think about many people watching.
I understand, dear. It's just a new way to communicate for me to get used to.
I get it, it can be a bit weird at first. But once you start chatting, it becomes second nature.
If you ever feel uncomfortable, we can just turn the camera off and figure it out together.
Oh, I see, dear. It sounds like a lot of fun and a great way to connect with others. I'm glad you're sharing this with me.
I'm really happy you're open to learning about streaming, Grandma. It's always more fun when we do it together.
